about.title: About HomeyPaw
about.tagline: A private family journal for your pet's whole life.
about.privacyBody: HomeyPaw processes the account, pet, family sharing, journal, photo, care record, and reminder data you choose to provide so it can deliver a private pet journal. Data is stored in Supabase and access is restricted through authentication, Row Level Security, and private Storage policies. Photo access is used only when you choose images. Notification access is used only for local reminders you enable on your device. HomeyPaw currently does not use advertising tracking, contacts, precise location, camera, microphone, or remote push notifications. You can delete your account and related data in the app. For support, email lenny996@163.com. A public policy URL will be added before release.
about.termsBody: You are responsible for your account credentials and family invite codes, and you may upload only content you have the right to use. Family members can view or manage shared pet data according to their role. Removing a member ends future access, while previously published content follows the data lifecycle described in the product. Reminders are an aid and are not a substitute for veterinary or emergency advice. The service may be temporarily unavailable for maintenance or network interruptions. Account and pet deletion cannot be undone. For support, email lenny996@163.com. A public terms URL will be added before release.

accountSecurity.title: Account and security
accountSecurity.subtitle: Manage your HomeyPaw account and private data.
accountSecurity.deleteDescription: Deleting your account permanently removes your login identity, profile and owned pets. It also permanently deletes journal entries, photos and care records you created in shared pet families. This cannot be undone.
accountSecurity.confirmBody: Your account and owned pet data will be permanently deleted. Journal entries, photos and care records you created in shared pet families will also be permanently deleted.
accountSecurity.finalConfirmBody: Deleting your account also permanently deletes journal entries, photos and care records you created in shared pet families. Delete your account now?
